notes.title: My Favourite Art Style: Neverending Nightmares
notes.notes:
As far as horror games go, Neverending Nightmares [official site] grainy, monochromatic animations set the perfect scene. The sketchy, hand-drawn shadows that guard its borders create an enduring sense of confinement, and the splashes of colour which dance their way into certain frames – stained glass windows, orange candlelight, radiant pink pocket flowers, and, of course, streams of crimson blood – serve to accentuate the perpetual darkness beyond, and the evils that often lie within.

… [visit site to read more]

notes.title: Follow up to Neverending Nightmares is on Kickstarter!
notes.notes:
Hi, 

I'm Matt Gilgenbach, the creative director at Infinitap Games. I am proud to announce that our next game Devastated Dreams is on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/infinitap/devastated-dreams]kickstarter now![/url] 

If you liked Neverending Nightmares, you'll love Devastated Dreams. It is a spiritual successor to our last game but will feature a plethora of improvements to the gameplay. It has a brand new story and characters and more of an emphasis on the narrative. Check out the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/infinitap/devastated-dreams]kickstarter[/url] and try our demo!

We have early bird rewards for the first week, so if you back now, you'll get the game cheaper than when it is on Steam and you can participate in the development process!

Thank you for your support of Neverending Nightmares, and we hope you like Devastated Dreams!

-Matt Gilgenbach

notes.title: Neverending Nightmares 1.4 release notes
notes.notes:
In Neverending Nightmares 1.4, we finally fixed the rendering problems for people with older Intel Integrated Graphics hardware including the Mobile Intel(R) 4 Series Express Chipset Family. This means the player will no longer appear black and the shading effect missing. If you are still having issues, please contact us at help@infinitapgames.com

Thank you for your patience with us to sort out this rendering issue!

notes.title: Halloween Sale and more languages added!
notes.notes:
Firstly, we are pleased to announce our participation in Steam's Halloween sale. The game is 25% off until November 3rd 10 am Pacific. 

We are even MORE pleased to announce Russian and Swedish localizations of the game are available in the 1.3 build of Neverending Nightmares. We hope to spread nightmares worldwide, so hopefully, we can add even more languages in subsequent versions. If you'd like to do a fan translation, feel free to contact me at translate@infinitapgames.com. It's around 500 words, so it isn't a huge effort.  

1.3 also features fixes another issue with the achievements that wasn't in the original 1.2 build.  

Thank you so much for your support!

notes.title: Neverending Nightmares 1.2 build is released!
notes.notes:
This build features numerous stability fixes. We also now save whether you've been awarded the achievements or not. If you are supposed to get the achievements, and you haven't gotten them, we will keep trying to award them for you. Unfortunately, since we didn't save this data previously, it means you'll have to playthrough the levels that award the achievements again to get them. I'm really sorry for the trouble!

Since release, we've patched in Turkish and Finnish translations. We welcome any new fan translations. Email translate@infinitapgames.com if you'd like to help us add any new languages.
